integrity: The conservation identity is proved algebraically from the published update and independently replayed with exact rational arithmetic. Novelty is supported by targeted source and database searches but is not an exhaustive literature proof.
scientific_limitations: The claim is confined to the forward update (3.1) with demographic terms omitted as in the numerical section; it does not assess convergence of the outer optimization algorithm or epidemiological inference.
title: Boundary-corrected positivity and exact mass conservation in the Liu–Tian SEIR step
